lines.en: : Sensei! Welcome back! Did you come all the way over here just to see me?
lines.zh: : Sensei！你回来啦！你是特意跑这么远来看我的吗？

lines.en: Chika grabs the sleeve of my jacket and pulls me over to watch something on her phone.
lines.zh: Chika 抓住我外套的袖子，把我拉过去看她手机上的东西。

lines.en: We hang out for a little while until Yumi screams something from the inside of her room again.
lines.zh: 我们待了一会儿，直到 Yumi 又在自己房间里喊了句什么。

lines.en: Chika ignores her a good three or four times before finally giving in and apologizing for her friend’s behavior.
lines.zh: Chika 装没听见足足三四次，最后还是妥协了，并为朋友的举动道歉。

lines.en: It would be nice to actually spend some time alone with her for once. I can feel the two of us getting closer.
lines.zh: 要是能真的和她独处一段时间就好了。我能感觉到我们俩在靠近。

lines.en: I guess I’ll just have to keep at it until then...
lines.zh: 看来只能一直坚持下去，直到那一天……

lines.en: Unfortunately, it winds up being some stupid K-pop dance video that I have to pretend to be interested in for the next five minutes.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，那是某个傻兮兮的韩舞视频，接下来五分钟我都得装出很有兴趣的样子。

lines.en: But hey, if that gets her to like me more...so be it.
lines.zh: 不过嘛，如果这能让她更喜欢我……那就这样吧。

lines.en: I'll put up with as many stupid dance videos as I have to.
lines.zh: 再蠢的舞蹈视频，我都忍。
